text:
inc-bot: @here P0 - High error rate observed on streaming API after sdk-js v2.3.0 rollout. Customer-facing 5xxs and streaming disconnects. Paging on-call.

maya (on-call SRE): I'm taking this. seeing spike in 5xxs starting ~09:14 UTC. Thanks for the ping.

liam (eng): Confirming: telemetry shows streaming connections failing with `ERR_PROTOCOL` and `CLOSE` frames. Non-stream endpoints are fine.

ash (SDK): Wait, v2.3.0 included a change to how we negotiate `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` for streams. Rolling release finished ~09:10 UTC.

caitlin (support): I'm getting a ticket from a large customer (Acme Corp) hitting timeouts, they said it started around 09:20 UTC.

maya (on-call SRE): Scope: streaming endpoints (chat.stream, gen.stream) 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 11.7% in prod us-west-2. Latency also up. Error signature: `400/500 during handshake - invalid content-length` in proxy logs.

liam (eng): Reproduced locally with sdk-js v2.3.0 using `node --version 18`. Looks like client now sets `content-length: 0` in some partial updates. server runtime treats that as non-chunked and closes early.

ash (SDK): Ack. This matches a quick fix we shipped to change streaming framing for connection keep-alive. Need to rollback or apply kill-switch.

maya (on-call SRE): Immediate mitigations: 1) flip feature flag `sdk_streaming_v2` to off for prod 2) initiate hot rollback of sdk release on CDN and package managers 3) open canary cutoff to stop further rollouts.

liam (eng): I can flip the flag. Running:
```
# prod
rctl flags set sdk_streaming_v2 false --env=prod --reason "streaming regressions"
```

liam (eng): Flag flip issued, waiting for propagation (~10s).

inc-bot: Flag update succeeded (sdk_streaming_v2=false) for env=prod.

maya (on-call SRE): Observing metrics... 1m after flip streaming 5xx down to 3.2% from 11.7%. Connections stabilizing.

ash (SDK): We'll still rollback the CDN and npm dist-tag for v2.3.0 to prevent new clients picking it up.

liam (eng): Rolling dist-tag: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.2.9 latest` and unpublishing the canary tag. Deploy bot will handle CDN.

deploy-bot: Started rollback: service=sdk-cdn action=promote version=2.2.9 target=latest by liam.

caitlin (support): Notifying affected customers: Acme, Atlas Health, and BetaApps. Sending them a note: "We're rolling back a client SDK change causing streaming disconnects; temporary mitigation applied and we expect full resolution within 30 minutes."

maya (on-call SRE): Quick impact note for incident channel: streaming degraded for ~09:10-09:25 UTC for many customers; mitigation applied (feature flag off + rollback started). No data loss observed but truncation possible for in-flight streams.

ash (SDK): Root cause hypothesis: change to framing negotiation caused some proxies to interpret request as non-chunked due to a `content-length: 0` header being set for initial preflight frames. Fix is to revert framing change and add explicit `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` handshake. Patch PR open: #4812.

liam (eng): CI for PR shows green on unit/integration. Will prepare a patched release v2.3.1 after rollback completes.

maya (on-call SRE): Can we get a quick customer impact list and eta?

caitlin (support): Impacted customers: Acme (high severity, streaming chat for agent routing), Atlas Health (moderate, background transcription), BetaApps (low). Notified via status page and direct email for priority customers.

ash (SDK): ETA for patched release 2.3.1 ~ 45 minutes after we confirm rollback fully propagated. We'll include a migration note and toggleable feature gate for safer rollout.

maya (on-call SRE): Post-mitigation monitoring shows 5xxs back to baseline (0.4%) by 09:34 UTC; keep observing until rollback finishes. I'll keep this thread as incident bridge.

liam (eng): Deploy-bot reports CDN promotion complete. npm dist-tag updated.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: service=sdk-cdn status=success time=09:38 UTC.

caitlin (support): Customer update: Acme confirms degraded behavior stopped around 09:36 UTC and they are resuming normal ops.

maya (on-call SRE): Transitioning to recovery state. Actions for postmortem: 1) revert v2.3.0 commit and release 2.3.1 with fix 2) add integration test for chunked handshake across proxies 3) update rollout checklist to gate streaming framing changes behind feature flag 4) follow-up with platform team on proxy behavior.

ash (SDK): I'll own the PR and the follow-up tests.

liam (eng): I'll own rollout checklist updates and the canary cutoff automation.

caitlin (support): I'll draft the customer post-incident email and update status page.

maya (on-call SRE): Thanks team. Closing paging notifications. Will open a postmortem doc and assign owners. If anything regress, re-ping this thread. :white_check_mark:

inc-bot: Incident P0 -> mitigated. Ticket: INC-2026-0347. Postmortem doc: /docs/incidents/INC-2026-0347-postmortem (draft)."
